title: Invent a different name for BeatBuddy 😭
body:
There is a commercial product called *BeatBuddy*. This could be a problem in the future, especially for SEO or legal issues.

I need to find another name that accurately reflects what this extension does. The name should be easy to remember and catchy.
author: centomila

comments.body:
> BeatPaul BeatPiet LinBeat BeatDice

Thanks, @Cris-- . After a night of sleep, I've opted for _BitwigBuddy_. I will rename the repo in the next release.

I'm adding more features for general use (general clip manipulation and other repetitive tasks), not just for "beats" or "drums." So Buddy stays, while "Beat" has to go. 😁

Thanks anyway for your suggestions! 🫂
